correctness.rationale: The graph is KG(5,2) with 15 edges, four *named* edge colours, and adjacency by one legal edge recolour. At each cubic vertex, recolouring an edge swaps its local colour with the missing one, changing each endpoint permutation sign; their product is invariant. The move criterion is equality of endpoint missing colours; frozen maps have pattern (4,2,2,2). Two exhaustive verifiers were inspected (DFS colour assignments versus four matching-class partitions). Independently generated 49,920 states, 109,440 edges, 960 isolated and two connected components of 24,480; verified degree/sign profiles. An independently constructed complete A5 x S4 orbit enumeration gave 42 orbits and 40 full BFS over mobile representatives, radius 24, diameter 25, eccentricity census 38,880 at 24 and 10,080 at 25. These finite computations are exhaustive over THIS graph, not a general cubic theorem.
